name: io.github.ussefidder/shopify-store-sync-mcp
title: Shopify Store Sync
description: Diff and sync Shopify stores: dry-run plans, cross-store ID remapping, never deletes.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STORES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your stores.json (store domains and how each one is connected). Defaults to ./stores.json.

environmentVariables.name: SYNC_SNAPSHOT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder that snapshot exports and dir: sources must stay inside. Defaults to the folder the server runs in.
